entities.name: PMID:25423566
observations: Primary 2015 J Clin Endocrinol Metab study of miR-219-5p in papillary thyroid carcinoma.
In 30 PTC and 30 normal thyroid specimens, miR-219-5p was reduced in PTC.
Forced miR-219-5p expression suppressed PTC-cell proliferation and migration and promoted apoptosis.

The study identified estrogen receptor alpha (ERα/ESR1) as a direct functional target using a reporter assay and rescue experiment; ERα overexpression rescued miR-219-5p-mediated inhibition of proliferation and migration.
